verdict: Organic visibility is softening; overdue pipeline work is the priority now.
narrative: Across all three entities this period, Google Business Profile was the sole demand channel, combining for 370 total actions — 13 calls, 269 directions, and 88 web clicks — with no paid spend active on any brand. Forte and Advance Grinding both saw sharp declines in local engagement over the last 7 days (down 62% and 59% respectively), with zero actions recorded on each in the final days of the window; O'Hare bucked that trend with a 36% week-over-week GBP spike, though that momentum also went quiet in the last three days. The underlying issue across all entities is the same: several CRM, outreach, and web milestones that were due as far back as July remain unresolved, which means the contact and email sequences that should be generating pipeline have not launched. Work to close those blockers — including the stub reconciliation, the Sales-i parser, the web root-cause fix, and the contact pulls needed to start outreach — is the active focus, with automations and reindexing targeted for completion by end of October.

watch_item.issue: GBP engagement collapsed to zero actions in the final days of the period for Forte and Advance Grinding, while several overdue pipeline milestones — including contact pulls, CRM stub reconciliation, and email sequence launches — have left outreach at a standstill across all brands.
watch_item.fix: The web root-cause fix, contact pulls, and CRM blockers are the active priority; site reindexing and the first outreach sequences are targeted to go live by end of October.
